attr.inst_md:
## Installation

Install Gunslugs2.zip with PortMaster on compatible 64-bit ARM Linux firmware. Connect to the network for Java 17 and Westonpack if they are not installed. Obtain the full Windows offline backup installer from your owned GOG library; install it or extract it with innoextract. Copy the unchanged Gunslugs2.jar to <ports directory>/gunslugs2/gamedata/Gunslugs2.jar. The supported archive is identified by its SHA-256 fingerprint below; other builds require a compatibility check.

## Supported Windows build

GOG full Windows offline backup installer containing a Gunslugs2.jar that matches the verified SHA-256 fingerprint below.

The supported archive SHA-256 is `8f92f9ea2f84b055be744f98b911dbcdc6f8199bd1ec75b54338bff3ffffa913`. Keep the original game data intact. Do not include the game files in the PortMaster ZIP or share them.
